`ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` wraps the APIV1 handler for Connect protocol. The business logic itself lives in `APIV1Service.SignIn`.
`APIV1Service.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` handles the SignIn RPC. The Connect wrapper delegates to it.
